<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.61</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.61">Released</a> on April 24, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump @babel/runtime-corejs3 from 7.17.8 to 7.27.0 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#14377)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryct] e2e tes for model search command @gourav-k-shaw (#14445)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] add csv import in model import command @riyaa14 (#14061)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add Capabilities check for  and support for proper navigation for designs @aabidsofi19 (#14500)</li>
  <li>fix filter crashes on non schema values @aabidsofi19 (#14505)</li>
  <li>Chore: Rename Registry components. @ritzorama (#14497)</li>
  <li>migrate _app component to functional based component @amitamrutiya (#14495)</li>
  <li>fix: remove react-error-boundary dependency @amitamrutiya (#14494)</li>
  <li>Bump dotenv from 16.4.5 to 16.4.7 in /ui @dependabot (#13437)</li>
  <li>feat: fix settings spec faliures @ianrwhitney (#14467)</li>
  <li>Enhance workspace table responsiveness and switcher @amitamrutiya (#14491)</li>
  <li>[UI] Workspaces: Icon color @leecalcote (#14486)</li>
  <li>feat: fixed pef playwright flainess @ianrwhitney (#14446)</li>
  <li>fix: null workspace fix @ianrwhitney (#14489)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump dotenv from 16.4.5 to 16.4.7 in /ui @dependabot (#13437)</li>
  <li>feat: fix settings spec faliures @ianrwhitney (#14467)</li>
  <li>feat: fixed pef playwright flainess @ianrwhitney (#14446)</li>
  <li>[mesheryct] e2e tes for model search command @gourav-k-shaw (#14445)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Add notes about the shape of deployment in the Component Shape Guide @weilirs (#13704)</li>
  <li>Fixed Auto-Generated Release Notes Rendering Issue with Square Brackets @vr-varad (#14026)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] adding details regarding –config flag  @gourav-k-shaw (#14474)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @dependabot, @gourav-k-shaw, @hamza-mohd, @ianrwhitney, @l5io, @leecalcote, @lekaf974, @ritzorama, @riyaa14, @vishalvivekm, @vr-varad, @weilirs, @zihanKuang and MUzairS15</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.63</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.63">Released</a> on April 25, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

  <li>add functionlity of change visibility in workspace design/view table @amitamrutiya (#14529)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.179 @l5io (#14503)</li>
  <li>use schems in model wizard from openapi files @amitamrutiya (#14451)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.64</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.64">Released</a> on April 26, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>A test of the Meshery Istio Adapter @leecalcote (#14493)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] add e2e tests for mesheryctl model view command @VinayCheripally (#14098)</li>
  <li>Test: E2E playwright test for model create and model import wizard @vr-varad (#14388)</li>
  <li>e2e tests for mesheryctl <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf</code> command @shinigami-777 (#14423)</li>
  <li>chore(mesheryctl-e2e): update tests to fix fail in ci @lekaf974 (#14540)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added custom provider button  @Aditi4275 (#14543)</li>
  <li>Fix: Informative and User Friendly Connections Modals @vr-varad (#14476)</li>
  <li>Test: E2E playwright test for model create and model import wizard @vr-varad (#14388)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.182 @l5io (#14544)</li>
  <li>fix: e.get is not a function error in workspace modal @amitamrutiya (#14537)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.181 @l5io (#14536)</li>
  <li>Fix styling in adapter page and migrate to functional component @amitamrutiya (#14534)</li>
  <li>fix: pagination in designs and view table  @amitamrutiya (#14535)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Chore] Update the go and alpine Docker images @thealberto (#14249)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] add e2e tests for mesheryctl model view command @VinayCheripally (#14098)</li>
  <li>Set appropriate permissions for GitHub workflows @Prajwal-kp-18 (#14168)</li>
  <li>Test: E2E playwright test for model create and model import wizard @vr-varad (#14388)</li>
  <li>e2e tests for mesheryctl <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf</code> command @shinigami-777 (#14423)</li>
  <li>chore(mesheryctl-e2e): update tests to fix fail in ci @lekaf974 (#14540)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Mesheryctl uses MeshKit for logging (or at least it should be) @leecalcote (#14347)</li>
  <li>Test: E2E playwright test for model create and model import wizard @vr-varad (#14388)</li>
  <li>e2e tests for mesheryctl <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf</code> command @shinigami-777 (#14423)</li>
  <li>Docs: Update about improving connection modal @vr-varad (#14542)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-security">🔒 Security</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fixed Cross-site Scripting (XSS) in prometheus_handlers.go @Sumitsh28 (#14241)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update the go and alpine Docker images @thealberto (#14249)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.66</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.66">Released</a> on May 01, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>add support for propely intercepting and relaying provider errors @aabidsofi19 (#14556)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Update README.md to correct the filter to display issues tagged \help wanted\ @SriramKa (#14551)</li>
  <li>added meshery-extensions org @Abhay12911 (#14548)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add custom provider button  @FaheemOnHub (#14578)</li>
  <li>Converting grafana class based component to functional based component @amitamrutiya (#14571)</li>
  <li>[GrafanaComponent.js] Refactor grafana component to a functional component @falgunmpatel (#14041)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.183 @l5io (#14563)</li>
  <li>fix : duplicate resource issue in workspace assignment modal @amitamrutiya (#14561)</li>
  <li>enhance double toolbar theme color in workspace table @amitamrutiya (#14559)</li>
  <li>refactor: migrate data fetching to RTK Query for various components. @FaheemOnHub (#14396)</li>
  <li>fix: e.get is not function error @amitamrutiya (#14558)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Regal Lint Workflow @marblom007 (#14580)</li>
  <li>Update model-generator.yml @marblom007 (#14562)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump net-imap from 0.5.6 to 0.5.7 in /docs @dependabot (#14557)</li>
  <li>Add include for additing training videos on individual contributing docs @vishalvivekm (#14564)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhay12911, @FaheemOnHub, @Jougan-0, @SriramKa, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @falgunmpatel, @hortison, @l5io, @leecalcote, @marblom007, @ritzorama, @vishalvivekm, MUzairS15 and Sriram K</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

      }
    });

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.67</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.67">Released</a> on May 02, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Relationship evaluation] add support for advanced matching strategies @aabidsofi19 (#14574)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump autoprefixer from 10.4.20 to 10.4.21 in /ui @dependabot (#14601)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 2.0.10 to 2.0.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14595)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/x-date-pickers from 7.26.0 to 8.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#14603)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump autoprefixer from 10.4.20 to 10.4.21 in /ui @dependabot (#14601)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 2.0.10 to 2.0.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14595)</li>
  <li>Bump @mui/x-date-pickers from 7.26.0 to 8.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#14603)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @aabidsofi19, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @l5io, @leecalcote, @miacycle, @ritzorama and MUzairS15</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.68</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.68">Released</a> on May 02, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: build failed @amitamrutiya (#14605)</li>
  <li>Bump @sistent/sistent from 0.14.156 to 0.14.183 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14598)</li>
  <li>Bump react-share from 4.4.1 to 5.2.2 in /ui @dependabot (#14600)</li>
  <li>Bump react-big-calendar from 1.17.1 to 1.18.0 in /ui @dependabot (#14602)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.7</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.7">Released</a> on January 08, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>use meshkit encoding @aabidsofi19 (#13176)</li>
  <li>remove close body @aabidsofi19 (#13175)</li>
  <li>Add support for retrying to fetch capabilities from remote provider @aabidsofi19 (#13167)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Deploy modal styling @aabidsofi19 (#13178)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @aabidsofi19, @leecalcote and @vishalvivekm</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.72</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.72">Released</a> on May 06, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix workspace modal crash in annonymous session @aabidsofi19 (#14635)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

@aabidsofi19</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.74</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.74">Released</a> on May 07, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: typo in workspace modal @amitamrutiya (#14639)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 15.2.4 to 15.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14596)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 15.2.0 to 15.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14594)</li>
  <li>Add UI route param to distinguish table view @FaheemOnHub (#14560)</li>
  <li>fix: e.get function is not defined issue @amitamrutiya (#14638)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump next from 15.2.4 to 15.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14596)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-config-next from 15.2.0 to 15.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#14594)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@FaheemOnHub, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya and @dependabot</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.76</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.76">Released</a> on May 08, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore(mesheryctl-workspace): update workspace command using reusable fetch and list function @lekaf974 (#14288)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>use view info component for  @amitamrutiya (#14648)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.185 @l5io (#14646)</li>
  <li>use both immutable and plain javascript for redux @amitamrutiya (#14645)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @amitamrutiya, @l5io, @leecalcote and @lekaf974</p>

 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.8.78</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.78">Released</a> on May 13, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>update generate handler @aabidsofi19 (#14677)</li>
  <li>fix: added connection name to remote provider @ianrwhitney (#14672)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

  <li>feat(mehseryctl-system): add e2e test on system check command @lekaf974 (#14643)</li>
  <li>[mod]: fixed script not running tests, modified script to be extensible @gentcod (#14671)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 2.0.10 to 2.0.11 in /ui @dependabot (#14599)</li>
  <li>fix: permission issue in workspace modal for anonymous user @amitamrutiya (#14678)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>feat(mehseryctl-system): add e2e test on system check command @lekaf974 (#14643)</li>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.8</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.8">Released</a> on January 09, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add staging-playground ns to valid_namespaces @sangramrath (#13180)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Enhance Meshery CLI dashboard commands and error messages for clarity and consistency @leecalcote (#13200)</li>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): unittest failing due to missing update after removing  <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">successfully</code> word @lekaf974 (#13039)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: test for dashboard charts failing @amitamrutiya (#13187)</li>
  <li>Enhance the dashboard resource detail view @amitamrutiya (#13183)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.137 @l5io (#13185)</li>
  <li>Update 404.js @aabidsofi19 (#13179)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix(mesheryctl): unittest failing due to missing update after removing  <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">successfully</code> word @lekaf974 (#13039)</li>
  <li>bump ubuntu for docker build and push @aabidsofi19 (#13182)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>marking-my-attendance-for-the-week-of-01-06-2025 @TheShubhendra (#13192)</li>
  <li>marking-my-attendance-for-the-week-of-01-06-2025 @M-DEV-1 (#13194)</li>
  <li>marking my attendance for the week of 01-06-2025 @Srishti-Chugh (#13195)</li>
  <li>marking-my-attendance-for-the-week-of-01-06-2025 @riyaa14 (#13196)</li>
  <li>marking-my-attendance-for-the-week-of-01-06-2025 @aadarsh-nagrath (#13197)</li>
  <li>marking-my-attendance-for-the-week-of-01-06-2025 @vishalvivekm (#13191)</li>
  <li>Update gitops-with-meshery.md @leecalcote (#13188)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

           <h1>Meshery v0.8.81</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.8.81">Released</a> on May 15, 2025</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Refactor timestamp handling to use Date.now() for consistency across … @amitamrutiya (#14703)</li>
  <li>Publish modal axios fetch migrated to rtk query @Pratik-050 (#14687)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.188 @l5io (#14698)</li>
  <li>Legacy Redux to Redux Toolkit Migration @amitamrutiya (#14665)</li>
  <li>Fix: Broken Workspace Author Link @vr-varad (#14695)</li>
  <li>[Chore]: Bump Sistent v0.14.187 @l5io (#14693)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Jougan-0, @Pratik-050, @aabidsofi19, @amitamrutiya, @l5io, @leecalcote, @mrmerlin320, @vishalvivekm, @vr-varad and MUzairS15</p>
